svg.title: A. Receive invoice — detailed background checks and ERP delivery
svg.desc: Detailed action A: automatic inbound receiving after source capture. The receiving phase band is above all swimlanes. Customer/accountant has no required action. ERP/product, E-Invoice Service and Other Services handle checks, repeats, original/copy holds, conditional Phase 3 conversion and verified ERP receipt. Customer consultation is shown separately in overview frames B–E and its API sequence.

No customer action is needed. Follow the source-choice flow first; receiving starts after an inbound invoice file is saved.
Solid: usual receiving steps. Dashed: conditional work, holds or recovery.
R marker: when the original arrives, return to receiving step 1. Keep one invoice and the same delivery ID.
DTS converts to UBL 2.5 only in Phase 3 when the received format is different. Keep the original and check the converted result.
Safe authorised consultation and file access can continue while ERP delivery waits. Source confirmation follows its own contract milestone.
ERP receipt is separate from accounting/import choices and buyer acceptance. Logical responsibilities; actual service coverage remains to be confirmed.
R: original arrives → return to step 1
